notes.title: Bugs & Minor Enhancements
notes.notes:
We have added some minor bug fixes : 

1. If you have triggered Monster into a chase, it will now stop chasing you if you advance to next level.

We have added some In-Play Hints messages

1. When interaction with an asset i.e a Console, switch or trigger is required, when player within vicinity of object a Hint Message will appear .
